verdict.rationale: Box documents an API reference at developer.box.com/reference with a runnable curl example: substitute a developer token and call /users/me. Its getting-started docs also walk users through generating a developer token and making a first API call. Nothing shows the reference is interactive (no in-browser try-it console or live request runner), and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec to drive one. Missing for 10: an interactive in-browser API explorer, runnable examples shown across endpoints rather than one curl snippet, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
